comments.author: @katherinecumbo5906
comments.text: I was born in Malta, but I live in Australia, I still call my self I am Maltese🇲🇹🇭🇲

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: Keeping that Maltese identity strong in Australia is beautiful, @katherinecumbo5906. We're honored this video could remind you of your roots!

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: We hear your skepticism, @Le0drag0n-76, especially since Malta is so highly developed! We were referring more to its ancient character and hidden coastal spots, but we appreciate the reality check.

comments.author: @LifewaysTravel
comments.text: If you had to choose, would you rather live in Malta for the Mediterranean lifestyle or on a larger island with more space and fewer tourists?

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: That is a tough choice, @LifewaysTravel! While the Mediterranean charm of Malta is tempting, the peace and space of a less-crowded island definitely have their own appeal. What about you?

comments.author: @CarmenDavies-x6h
comments.text: The young Maltese have always lived at home with their parents till they get married ,nothing new,they know where their bread is buttered.

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: That is a fascinating look into the local cultural norms, @CarmenDavies-x6h. It really highlights the strong family bonds that remain so central to life in Malta!

comments.author: @stephaniespiteri3290
comments.text: I am Proud Maltese. Malta rich in histroy, culture,traditions.

replies.author: @buggyridge
replies.text: Resource issues concern me greatly as a conservationist. How does the island handle the waste and septic issues?

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: It was an absolute honor to document your beautiful country, @stephaniespiteri3290. Malta’s rich heritage is truly world-class, and we're glad you felt the pride in our film!

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: You have every reason to be proud, @Josephine-xv6pu! Malta is a stunning island with such a rich and deep history. Thank you for tuning in!

comments.author: @ultimateplanet4k
comments.text: We truly appreciate your kindness. There are so many more beautiful destinations to discover together! 🌍

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: It’s a pleasure to have you with us, @ultimateplanet4k. Let’s keep exploring the world's beauty together!

comments.author: @DiscoverGlobePlacesTop10_NL158
comments.text: Malta a Mediterranean paradise, or an island being suffocated by tourism itself ?

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: That is a very thought-provoking question, @DiscoverGlobePlacesTop10_NL158. It seems to be a delicate balance between the economic benefits of tourism and preserving the island's authentic charm.

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: We love it too! Thank you for the support, @HorizonHidden, and for taking the time to watch our Malta documentary.

comments.author: @PhạmTháiLong-s1y
comments.text: Walking past those golden limestone walls every evening as the Mediterranean breeze carries the scent of sea salt and fresh ftira... Malta is small on the map, but our history and soul run thousands of years deep. Thank you for showing the quiet, authentic heartbeat of our island behind the postcard views.

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: Your description of the sea salt and ftira scent is so evocative, @PhạmTháiLong-s1y. It was an honor to document the ancient and authentic heartbeat of your beautiful home!

comments.author: @UntoldEarthDocs_Us
comments.text: The fact that some young Maltese with stable jobs still live with their parents into their 30s because housing has become so expensive really stood out to me. Is this becoming the new normal everywhere, or has Malta’s housing situation gone too far?

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: That is a very complex issue, @UntoldEarthDocs_Us. While housing costs are rising globally, Malta's limited space definitely makes the situation even more intense.

comments.author: @ThompsonRyan-u4h
comments.text: I’m honestly surprised by how beautiful Malta is. 🇲🇹 The mix of ancient history, Mediterranean landscapes, and everyday island life is fascinating. Would you rather spend a week exploring Malta’s historic streets or relaxing by the sea? 🌊

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: It's hard to pick just one, but exploring the historic streets feels like stepping back in time, @ThompsonRyan-u4h. Thanks for such an engaging question!

comments.author: @BeyondOurPlanet001
comments.text: I love Malta because of it's great limestone

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: The limestone architecture definitely gives the island a unique character, wouldn't you agree @BeyondOurPlanet001? Thanks for tuning in!
